segments.ja130:1.1: Yathā vācā ca bhuñjassu, yathā bhuttañca byāhara;
segments.ja130:1.3: Ubhayaṃ te na sameti, vācā bhuttañca kosiyeti.
segments.ja130:4.1: Kusanāḷisirivhayano ca yasaṃ, dadhi mamba kaṭāhakapañcamako;
segments.ja130:4.3: Atha pāpaka khīra biḷāravataṃ, sikhi kosiyasavhayanena dasāti.
